checklist: Keep this PC offline. Don't log in to anything from it until it's cleaned.
From another device (your phone), change your passwords: email first (it resets everything else), then banking, then anything saved in this PC's browsers.

Log out everywhere: stolen browser cookies keep sessions alive after a password change. Use 'Sign out of all devices' for Google, Microsoft, Discord, Steam, Telegram (Settings > Devices > Terminate all), social media.
Crypto: move funds to a NEW wallet created on a clean device. Treat every seed phrase this PC has ever seen as burned.
Turn on 2FA with an authenticator app (not SMS) for important accounts.
Run a Microsoft Defender Offline scan, then strongly consider resetting Windows: stealers often drop more malware.
Look the file up on VirusTotal from another device: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/9f2c41d077ab03e5c1b6f28e4d9a0c73b5e18d2f6a4c90b7e3d1f5a8c2b6e41b

It packed them into a zip in your Temp folder, with the Discord bait.
It looked up where you are (ip-api.com) before it opened anything of yours, and sent nothing after.
steps: Kill NitroGen-Free.exe: it's still frozen. Killing it ends it for good and keeps the evidence.
Sign out of every site in Chrome: stolen cookies let someone be you without a password. Signing out makes them useless.
Change your Discord password, then log out all other sessions in Discord's settings.

lines: Caught on Fri Nov 27 2026 at 14:02:07, the moment it opened the bait (stopped 120 ms after).
Done: Froze it and 1 process(es) it started
Done: Cut its internet
To answer it, type one of these in a command window opened as administrator (or answer ABA's first popup about it):
aba kill 7f3a  it's malware: end it (it stays cut off)
aba trust 7f3a  it's yours: undo everything and stop alerting about it
aba resume 7f3a  not sure: let it run again, without trusting it

sections.title: Evidence
